feedback: Written before this candidate has raced; no outcome is stated for it. (1) Iteration 4 (5 sensors, +/-3 cm, 1.5 cm pitch, 4 cm lead, 16 mm) is the best reference: s-bend 0.155, oval 0.11, one line loss per run (entityR2B). The controller works at this lead and footprint. (2) Iterations 2 and 5 both used 2 cm pitch and both collapsed s-bend progress to 0.04. Iteration 5 kept the 4 cm lead, so the collapse there cannot be blamed on the lead, but its span also changed. Iteration 0 used 1 cm pitch and did not collapse (s-bend 0.15). Pitch is therefore the leading suspect, not yet proven. (3) Leads below 4 cm are harmful: iteration 3 (2 cm lead) and iteration 2 (3 cm lead) both collapsed s-bend progress. (4) rms_error stayed near 0.03 and steering_oscillation between 0.065 and 0.155 in every iteration, so jitter is not the limit. Next race: if s-bend progress returns to 0.15 or above with 1 cm pitch and line losses fall, keep the 1 cm pitch and try a footprint change to 0.012 m to see whether the extra sensors are being over-weighted. If s-bend progress stays at 0.04 or falls below 0.11, pitch is not the cause, so return to the 5-sensor iteration 4 layout and test a different variable, such as the span or the line_loss setting. If progress is unchanged but line losses stay at 1, the line_loss setting is the lever to test.

If s-bend progress falls below 0.11 with 1 cm pitch, return to the iteration 4 five-sensor layout at 1.5 cm pitch (x = -0.03, -0.015, 0, 0.015, 0.03) and test sensor_size 0.012 alone, since iteration 1 with 12 mm footprints gave 0.155 and iteration 4 with 16 mm gave 0.155.
